canonical_project: Killellan AI Growth Zone / Sovereign AI Cloud

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Killellan/Cowal Peninsula proposal near Dunoon. Argyll Data Development says the campus will supply power directly to a data centre and has partnered with SambaNova. DCD reported an initial 100-600MW campus scalable higher; the AI Growth Zone application includes council/MSP support letters. A later APRS report says the project may be stalled by grid connection delays.
